highlights: A Rust-powered workflow engine that runs on your device — laptop, server, or phone..
Flow-Like is a visual workflow automation platform that runs entirely on your hardware.

Build workflows with drag-and-drop blocks, run them on your laptop, phone, or server, and get a clear record of where data came from, what changed, and what came out — no cloud dependency, no black boxes, no guesswork.
You decide where your workflows run.
Most workflow tools force you into their cloud.
Automate on your couch without Wi-Fi.
Your workflows, your infrastructure, your rules.
The same workflow that takes 500ms in a Node.js engine takes 0.6ms in Flow-Like.
